name: Mateo Rodriguez
bio:
Mateo Rodriguez's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in Buenos Aires, where he spent countless hours tinkering with go-karts and dreaming of Formula 1 glory. While his racing aspirations shifted towards a more practical application of his talents, his love for the sport never wavered. After graduating with a degree in accounting, Mateo sought opportunities within the motorsport industry, landing a role as a junior financial analyst at a local racing team.

His meticulous nature and ability to remain composed under pressure quickly impressed his superiors, leading to a promotion to finance controller. Mateo thrives on the challenges of managing complex budgets and ensuring the financial stability of the team. He views his role as more than just crunching numbers; he sees it as a critical component of the team's success, providing the foundation for innovation and on-track performance. His dedication to accuracy and his understanding of the financial implications of every decision make him a valuable asset to Hansen World RX Team.

Mateo is known for his collaborative spirit and his ability to translate complex financial data into easily understandable insights for team members. He is driven by a desire to contribute to the team's victories and to ensure the long-term financial health of the organization.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Mateo is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down financial insights or ideas.
Has a collection of miniature racing cars on his desk.
Prefers to work with classical music playing softly in the background.
